title: weekly_metrics
description: One row per (week, team, platform). Weekly aggregate delivery, code-health, quality-practice, efficiency and operational metrics. Event counts (deployments) must reconcile with deployments.csv.

week_start.description: Monday that starts the reporting week (ISO 8601).

platform.description: Technology platform the work ships on.

team_headcount.description: Engineers on the team that week. Same value on every platform row for a team/week.

failed_deployments.description: Deployments that failed (and caused degraded service or needed remediation).

rollbacks.description: Failed deployments that were rolled back.

cycle_time_days.description: Median time from first commit to production for items finished this week.

lead_time_days.description: Median time from work item creation to production. Must be >= cycle_time_days.

pr_review_time_hours.description: Median time from PR opened to approved.

avg_pr_size_loc.description: Mean lines changed per merged PR.

review_latency_hours.description: Median time from PR opened to first review comment.

rework_rate_pct.description: Share of changed lines that rewrite code less than 21 days old.

test_coverage_pct.description: Line coverage of the team's services on this platform at week end.

automated_test_pct.description: Share of test cases that are automated.

ci_failure_rate_pct.description: Share of CI runs that failed.

queue_time_min.description: Median wait before a CI job starts.

availability_pct.description: Measured availability of the team's services on this platform.

x-validation-rules.rule: record_id is unique and (week, team, platform) is unique.
deployments, failed_deployments and rollbacks equal the counts of matching rows in deployments.csv.
team_headcount is identical across all platform rows of the same team and week.
week_start == settings.start_date + 7 * (week - 1); weeks are contiguous; every (team, platform) in services.csv has a row for every week.
